LESSON: SIMPLE POSTURES

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Simple postures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Simple postures. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: hown 1. How does yoga help us?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the body parts used for postures in the practice of yoga
2. demonstrate simple yoga for physical wellbeing
3. c. appreciate the the practice of simple postures importance of yoga for as a group activity better health.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name the body parts used for postures in the practice of yoga
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to name the body parts used for postures in the practice of yoga. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate simple yoga for physical wellbeing
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate simple yoga for physical wellbeing. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. c. appreciate the the practice of simple postures importance of yoga for as a group activity better health.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to c. appreciate the the practice of simple postures importance of yoga for as a group activity better health. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Simple postures.
2. Explain Simple postures to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Simple postures.
4. Show that you can: name the body parts used for postures in the practice of yoga
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Simple postures. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: hown 1. How does yoga help us?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. name the body parts used for postures in the practice of yoga
2. demonstrate simple yoga for physical wellbeing
3. c. appreciate the the practice of simple postures importance of yoga for as a group activity better health.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
